rv.q: The high energy hijinx are completely absorbing and largely entertaining.
Overall, Viva la Mort deserves credit for being an imaginative (if sometimes annoyingly repetitious) reconstruction of Dürrenmatt’s story.
"Viva La Mort" is a daring theatrical piece that pushes the boundaries of traditional storytelling.

cn.t: This ambitious neo-commedia adaptation of Dürrenmatt's "The Visit" brings high-energy spectacle to the classic tale of revenge and moral corruption, earning modest praise for its bold theatrical style.
